title: The v1 Big Bang timeline numerals are still unsourced
summary: The v1 minute-by-minute timeline and light-element percentages are still not copied from a source. The age figure is on the Planck card.
body: The v1 Big Bang article added a minute-by-minute timeline and light-element percentages. Those numerals are still not copied from a source opened for that article. The age figure is no longer left as an unsourced slogan: world.cosmology.planck-2018-age records the age printed in the Planck 2018 paper, from the manuscript opened on 18 November 2026. This card does not repeat that number.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
